36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
212393: Heir to house Ulster, a renowned line of fire mages. He has one younger sister. Following a certain incident during his first year at the academy, he became painfully aware of Will and began to see him as a rival.
212394: Will Serfort is a sixth year student at the Regarden Magical Academy shunned by most students and faculty due to his lack of magical aptitude. To make up for his lack of magic, Will trains his body and swordsmanship in the dungeon.
212395: An ascendant who made it to the top of the Tower, earning the qualification to become Magia Vander, before being defeated by another candidate. He now works as a professor at Regarden Magical Academy, where he teaches Dark Magic and History and Origins of Magic.
212586: Only daughter of house Loire, a fallen family of nobles. She specializes in earth magic, but struggles considerably with any spell requiring precision. Colette befriended Will following a certain incident during her first year at the academy.
326398: A true prodigy and the youngest Magia Vander in history, she watches over a certain young man from her windowsill in the Tower. Those close to her say she is an easygoing Magia Vander who likes to play the saint. Will's childhood friend who specializes in ice magic.
327988: Will's familiar and pet. Kiki is a carbuncle, capable of casting reflective magic to protect Will in emergencies.
327989: A skilled magical artificer and Will's roommate. His boundless affection for Will is enough to make Colette nervous. While lacking any natural gift for artificing, he has become a great talent and often devises various magical items under the pretense of making them for Will.
327990: An ice mage and one of the top three students in Will's year. He is a typical noble, with pride and self-assurance to spare. Since the incident at the magic festival, he has been forced to work at Gina's bar.
331143: Born to the knight family of Owenzaus. Her abilities have made her the best in her year and earned her the nickname of "Miss Perfect." She specializes in thunder magic.
331144: An elf who transferred to the academy from Alfswood, located in the far north Urbus region. In accordance with elven customs, he only permits physical contact with those he has deemed worthy. Shares the same dream as a certain no-talent. He specializes in wind and illusion magic.
336095: Professor of Magizoology. As one of the few people who understands Will, he always worries when Will pushes himself too hard. Though he tends to show his love for his students by being strict with them, this has made him an object of terror at the academy.
337446: A female watcher whose true identity remains unknown, even to most people in the Tower. She attends the academy as a student, and when she discovers someone with exceptional talent (especially those who are deemed unworthy by academy standards), she scouts them for the Tower.
337472: The leader of the Light Faction and the king of the "Five Supreme Staves," wielding the staff known as "Masterious Noah.
337477: One of the Magia Vende. Leader of the Elf Faction.
339972: Sixth year student at Rigarden Magical Academy.
339973: Sixth year student at Rigarden Magical Academy.
341267: He is a middle-aged dwarf living in the central magical city and is close to Will. A skilled blacksmith, he crafted Will's sword, "Moria's Sword-Silver.

343053: Student at Rigarden Magical Academy. He is the announcer for the Great Magic Festival.
